$comment: One template for every repo's GitHub Project, from docs/project-boards.md (ADR 0024). groupBy, sortBy and columnBy are set by hand in the UI (the API cannot set them) and read back by check. The board's columns are the Stage issue field. Status's options and its value on every card follow Stage (issue 176); the sync is the one script that writes Status on items. Priority is the org number field 1-100 (100 = do first).

stage.$comment: The org's Stage field, and every board's Status, follow these options (issue 176, ADR 0028). Order is the column order. A rename keeps the issues' values: write the new name and "was": the old one.

options.name: Inbox
options.description: Written, not yet ready for an agent. The default.

options.name: Ready
options.description: Spec complete. An agent may start.

options.name: Working
options.description: An agent is on it. Don't start a second one.

options.name: Asking
options.description: The agent asked the owner something. The last comment says what to do. No PR yet.

options.name: In validation
options.description: Work done. A complete PR waits for the owner: review, try it, check it.

views.name: Needs me
views.manual: Group by Stage. Sort by Priority descending (100 first).

views.name: Flow
views.manual: Column field: Stage (test T8: drag a card and check the issue's Stage changed). Sort by Priority descending. No column limit: GitHub refuses one on an issue-field column (T11, 2026-11-11). Add the Type column by hand if the UI offers it: the API exposes no Type field, so check does not verify it.

views.name: Epics
views.manual: Group by Milestone. Sort by Priority descending.

views.name: Shipped
views.manual: Sort by Updated, newest first. Add the Type column by hand if the UI offers it: the API exposes no Type field, so check does not verify it.

workflowNote: Set them after build: build replaces the Status options, and a workflow set before it shows a red ! until edited. The API reads only whether each one is on: not its target value, not auto-add's filter. It doesn't list Item reopened, Code changes requested, Code review approved or Auto-archive items: keep those OFF by hand.

workflowStates.name: Item added to project
workflowStates.note: Through the reconciler it would overwrite Stage

workflowStates.name: Auto-add to project
workflowStates.note: Repo boards: this repo, filter is:issue is:open, until the periodic job (issue 78) adds missing issues. The template has none: it is linked to no repo, and copies don't inherit it

access: Settings → Manage access: visibility private to the org, base role Write for members. Ready is guarded by the auto-start allowlist (issue 76), not by the project's permissions.
